title: After washing & drying there still very rough &  Pricey. Don’t waste your money.
text:
After washing & drying there still very rough & Pricey. Don’t waste your money.. These hospital sheets are a pleasant nice medium color blue.
This is a set of one top sheet, one stardard pillow case, and a odd bottom - somewhat fitted sheet.
Thats about the only good thing I can say nice about these hospital sheets!

I washed these in my new front loader washer, and dryer with a dryer sheet, and 4 wool dryer balls.
There definitely Not a Soft Polyester / cotton, there were still rough after washing and drying etc.
Looking at the inside of the pillow case after drying, all the seam where frayed and allot of threads.
It say’s “ knit fabric allows for improved circulation”? These are Not Knit.

Besides having a king size bed in our guest bedroom, I figured these sheets would work for a futon bed , or a day bed that has a pull out , and also to use for a electric blow-up bed that has a fleece top , for when our kids are here for the holidays.
I would not use these small Uncomfortable sheets.

The bottom sheet is what they call fitted!
There is a cheesy elastic around the top, and bottom only. Nothing on the sides.
The pockets are Not deep.
As per the meadurments for the top sheet, its small and all these sheets are a Thin slidding material.

Two years ago I was in the hospital for 4 days with Pneumonia, and believe me, these where Not the linens that where used.

You can buy from Amazon a soft set of king size Linens for the price of this high price hospital sheets.
For a twin set of sheets you can buy them for half of the price of these hospital sheets.
These are very pricey.

I do not recommend these sheets.
